briefings.title: Epstein Files News LIVE: Howard Lutnick Faces Closed-Door Grilling By House Oversight Committee
briefings.tldr: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faced a four-and-a-half-hour closed-door grilling by the House Oversight Committee regarding contradictions between his public statements and his documented history with Jeffrey Epstein, while a federal judge unsealed a 2019 suicide note from Epstein’s initial failed attempt.

briefings.title: The View Full Broadcast – May 7, 2026
briefings.tldr: The investigation into Jeffrey Epstein intensifies as Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces allegations of lying to Congress regarding his ties to the financier, while a deadly hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship triggers global health concerns and comparisons to the COVID-19 pandemic.
